question.en: What is your full name, exactly as written on your Aadhaar or ID card?
question.ta: உங்கள் ஆதார் அல்லது அடையாள அட்டையில் உள்ளபடி உங்கள் முழுப் பெயர் என்ன?
question.hi: आपका पूरा नाम क्या है, जैसा आपके आधार या पहचान पत्र पर लिखा है?
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଆଧାର ବା ପରିଚୟ ପତ୍ରରେ ଯେପରି ଲେଖାଅଛି, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପୂରା ନାମ କ'ଣ?

full_name.explain: Write your name exactly as it appears on your ID proof. If the spelling differs between documents, offices often reject the form or ask for an affidavit.

question.en: What is your father's or husband's/wife's name?
question.ta: உங்கள் தந்தை அல்லது கணவர்/மனைவியின் பெயர் என்ன?
question.hi: आपके पिता या पति/पत्नी का नाम क्या है?
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବାପା କିମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱାମୀ/ସ୍ତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ନାମ କ'ଣ?

father_or_spouse_name.explain: Many Indian forms ask for 'S/o, D/o or W/o' - son of, daughter of or wife of. Give either your father's name or your spouse's name, as on your ID.

question.en: What is your date of birth? (for example 15/08/1990)

date_of_birth.explain: Use the date printed on your Aadhaar, PAN or birth certificate, in day/month/year order.

gender.explain: Choose the gender shown on your ID proof.

marital_status.explain: Whether you are single, married, widowed or divorced.

question.hi: आपका 10 अंकों का मोबाइल नंबर क्या है?
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ 10 ଅଙ୍କ ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର କ'ଣ?

mobile.explain: Give a number you can receive OTPs and SMS on. For bank and Aadhaar-linked services, use the number linked to your Aadhaar if possible.

email.explain: Optional on most forms. Receipts and status updates are sent here if you give one.

question.en: What is your full address? (house number, street, area, city)
question.ta: உங்கள் முழு முகவரி என்ன? (வீட்டு எண், தெரு, பகுதி, நகரம்)
question.hi: आपका पूरा पता क्या है? (मकान नंबर, गली, इलाका, शहर)
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପୂରା ଠିକଣା କ'ଣ? (ଘର ନମ୍ବର, ରାସ୍ତା, ଅଞ୍ଚଳ, ସହର)

address.explain: Your current address. It should match your address proof; if it doesn't, you will usually need a separate proof of current address.

question.ta: உங்கள் 6 இலக்க அஞ்சல் குறியீட்டு (PIN) எண் என்ன?
question.hi: आपका 6 अंकों का पिन कोड क्या है?
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ 6 ଅଙ୍କ ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ପିନ୍ କୋଡ୍ କ'ଣ?

pincode.explain: The 6-digit postal code of your area. You'll find it on your Aadhaar or any letter you've received.

question.hi: आपका 12 अंकों का आधार नंबर क्या है?
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ 12 ଅଙ୍କ ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ଆଧାର ନମ୍ବର କ'ଣ?

aadhaar.explain: The 12-digit number on your Aadhaar card. Form Saathi checks it with the official checksum but never stores it after your session ends.

question.en: What is your PAN number? (10 characters, like ABCDE1234F)
question.ta: உங்கள் PAN எண் என்ன? (10 எழுத்துகள், உதாரணம் ABCDE1234F)
question.hi: आपका पैन (PAN) नंबर क्या है? (10 अक्षर, जैसे ABCDE1234F)
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ PAN ନମ୍ବର କ'ଣ? (10 ଅକ୍ଷର, ଯେପରି ABCDE1234F)

pan.explain: Permanent Account Number from the Income Tax Department, printed on your PAN card. If you don't have a PAN, banks accept Form 60 instead.

question.en: What is your bank account number?
question.hi: आपका बैंक खाता नंबर क्या है?

account_number.explain: Printed on the first page of your passbook and on your cheque leaves.

question.en: What is your bank branch's IFSC code? (11 characters, printed on your passbook or cheque)
question.ta: உங்கள் வங்கிக் கிளையின் IFSC குறியீடு என்ன? (11 எழுத்துகள், பாஸ்புக் அல்லது காசோலையில் இருக்கும்)
question.hi: आपकी बैंक शाखा का IFSC कोड क्या है? (11 अक्षर, पासबुक या चेक पर छपा होता है)
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଶାଖାର IFSC କୋଡ୍ କ'ଣ? (11 ଅକ୍ଷର, ପାସବୁକ୍ ବା ଚେକ୍‌ରେ ଛପା ଥାଏ)

ifsc.explain: IFSC identifies your bank branch for transfers. The 5th character is always zero.

question.en: What is your occupation? (for example farmer, salaried, business, student, homemaker)
question.ta: உங்கள் தொழில் என்ன? (உதாரணம்: விவசாயி, சம்பளம் பெறுபவர், வியாபாரம், மாணவர், இல்லத்தரசி)
question.hi: आपका व्यवसाय क्या है? (जैसे किसान, नौकरी, व्यापार, छात्र, गृहिणी)
question.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ବୃତ୍ତି କ'ଣ? (ଯେପରି ଚାଷୀ, ଚାକିରି, ବ୍ୟବସାୟ, ଛାତ୍ର, ଗୃହିଣୀ)

occupation.explain: What you do for a living. Banks ask this as part of KYC to understand the expected type of transactions in your account.

question.en: Which town or city are you signing this form in?
question.hi: आप यह फॉर्म किस शहर या कस्बे में भर रहे हैं?
question.or: ଆପଣ ଏହି ଫର୍ମ କେଉଁ ସହର ବା ଗାଁରେ ଦସ୍ତଖତ କରୁଛନ୍ତି?

place.explain: The 'Place' next to your signature - just the name of your town or city.

question.en: Which bank and branch is this for? (for example SBI, Anna Nagar)
question.ta: இது எந்த வங்கி மற்றும் கிளைக்கு? (உதாரணம் SBI, Anna Nagar)
question.hi: यह किस बैंक और शाखा के लिए है? (जैसे SBI, Anna Nagar)
question.or: ଏହା କେଉଁ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ଓ ଶାଖା ପାଇଁ? (ଯେପରି SBI, Saheed Nagar)

branch_name.explain: The bank name and branch where your account is (or will be). It is printed at the top of your passbook.
